summary.intent: Complete a multi-part todo on PR #507: implement idempotent re-key helpers, fix restoreFromBin ordering, add bounded Rust retry, then resolve all open PR review comments.
summary.outcome: All todo items shipped and pushed (commit f6c720f48), CI E2E dispatched and monitored, one open CodeRabbit review thread resolved with a tightened test assertion, PR comment posted summarizing the changes.

repo: cipher-box uses a monorepo with packages/sdk (TypeScript) and a Rust desktop layer with FUSE support; SDK tests run via pnpm, Rust via cargo check --features fuse.
The SDK has a clear CAS-merge pattern: moveItem commits dest state after re-key so a retry reconciles correctly; restoreFromBin needed the same publish→re-key→remove ordering.

integration.test.ts failures are environmental (no local API stack) — requires docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d + pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api dev before re-running; not a regression signal.
CI E2E workflow is ci-e2e.yml, dispatches on branch ref, covers Web E2E + Desktop E2E (linux/windows/macos), takes ~25-40 min.

code.finding: New shared helper reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange used by both moveItem and restoreFromBin; if source-key decrypt fails it confirms under dest key (idempotent retry), non-decrypt errors propagate.

CodeRabbit flagged that both folder publishes used the same 'publish' marker, making ordering assertions weak. Fixed by using distinct markers so a wrong source→reencrypt→dest sequence would actually fail the test.

workflow: gh run watch with --exit-status used for background CI monitoring; re-invokes assistant automatically on completion.
GraphQL reviewThreads query used to fetch unresolved PR threads; REST used for reply (--field for integer in_reply_to), GraphQL mutation for resolveReviewThread.
Commit verification: check gpgsig presence in git log output; missing local verifier config produces an 'error' but remote validation still works.
For idempotent retry patterns: always check if the operation already completed under the destination state before treating decrypt failure as an error.

friction: Local API stack not running means integration.test.ts always fails locally — requires manual docker compose + API server startup before a full SDK test run is meaningful.
GPG signature verification shows an error locally due to missing verifier config, which looks alarming but is benign for remote CI.
open_items: CI E2E run 27726086083 was still in_progress at end of session — result (Web E2E + Desktop linux/windows/macos) not yet confirmed.
The Rust retry is in-memory only (not a new JournalOp) per the todo's scope call — persistent journal entry for the re-key operation was explicitly deferred.
Live API integration tests require local stack (docker compose + API dev server) — no automation or skip marker in place for CI-less environments.
